To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the NEPSAC controller has the best performance, followed by the EPSAC controller and then by the gain scheduling array of autotuning PID controllers.
the EPSAC controller is the best option to control a soft nonlinear system such as a three tank system, followed by the gain scheduling approach with an array of auttuned PID controllers.

NEPSAC controller is able to deal with nonlinearities in a more accurate way, and EPSAC controller is a good alternative for nonlinear systems when there is not an accurate nonlinear model of the system.

the application of advanced control strategies to the regulation of the liquid level in three tanks in cascade.

the use of model-based control strategies is the best choice for nonlinear processes.
